title: Write a request: Orbi Cloud drafts your GitHub Issue
summary: Write a request in Orbi Cloud: describe a change, review a GitHub Issue draft, answer open questions, and hand it off. See merge controls and trial costs.
zhTitle: 写需求：说一句话，Orbi Cloud 替你写好 GitHub Issue

title: Pi agent harness: CLI, AI SDK, Pi Durable vs kill -9
summary: I ran the Pi agent harness three ways (pi --print, the AI SDK's HarnessAgent, Cloudflare's PiHarness) and killed each mid-task. What came back, and why.
zhTitle: Pi agent harness 三种跑法：kill -9 之后谁能接上

title: Pi + DeepSeek Flash, 169 merged PRs: 8–16¢ each
summary: In model tokens at DeepSeek off-peak prices, 169 merged deliveries cost a median of $0.082 each. One issue through four Pi sessions; what Pi leaves out.
zhTitle: Pi + DeepSeek Flash 写的 169 个已合并 PR：token 中位成本 8–16 美分

title: Claude Code headless mode: run it unattended
summary: Claude Code headless mode (claude -p) runs one session unattended, logged in with an API key or setup-token. Picking work, review and merge are on you.
zhTitle: Claude Code headless 模式是什么？自动化开发还差六件事

title: Searching for Orbi's harness, part 2: guard cost
summary: On eight unseen bugs whose Issue shows only a narrow example, Orbi's original harness failed a third of its runs. Five designs to cut the cost of the fix.
zhTitle: 给 Orbi 找 harness（下）：回归防护值不值它的 token

title: Searching for Orbi's harness, part 1: review gaps
summary: Orbi's review passed two fixes that each broke something. We rebuilt the harness one rule at a time and reran the loop on failed and unseen issues.
zhTitle: 给 Orbi 找 harness（上）：我们的评审漏掉了什么

title: GitSpawn and the agent that never asks
summary: A git flaw hit seven coding agents by skipping their approval prompts. Orbi has none to skip, so we shipped a fix, checked who runs git, and reverted it.
zhTitle: GitSpawn 绕开的是审批，我们的 agent 本来就不审批

title: DeepSeek coding agent cost per merged PR
summary: See how Orbi uses DeepSeek as an unattended coding agent, what each merged PR costs, why cache reads matter, and how to connect your own API key.
zhTitle: 用 DeepSeek 当无人值守的编程智能体：每合并一个 PR 花多少钱

title: Why Orbi is open source again
summary: Orbi began on Apache-2.0 and switched to the Sustainable Use License on Sep 4. From v0.5.44 it is AGPL-3.0, or the SUL if AGPL is ruled out. Here is why.
zhTitle: Orbi 为什么又改回开源：从 Apache 到 AGPL-3.0

title: The k8e etcd ticket that closed too early
summary: Orbi wrote an etcd test suite for k8e, a 497-star Kubernetes distro. It was rejected, fixed and merged, and the four-phase issue closed after phase one.
zhTitle: Orbi 给 k8e 写 etcd 测试：先被打回，合并后票又关错了

title: How one slash command got its shape
summary: A close look at the name, syntax, regex anchor, and registry behind one in-ticket command, compared with Prow and bors-ng and checked against their source.
zhTitle: 一条斜杠命令在票里是怎么定下来的：从名字到权限边界

title: The engine waited for an answer users could not give
summary: Our engine paused for a human decision, then asked tenants to use a command they did not have. Three versions of the same mistake in one afternoon.
zhTitle: 引擎等来的答案，托管用户给不了：三个交互缺口记录

title: Seven steps of an Orbi Cloud setup, on video
summary: An 83-second video follows the Orbi Cloud setup from GitHub sign-in to a tagged release and subscription. The final step starts paid Cloud delivery here.
zhTitle: Orbi Cloud 七步上手流程，83 秒看完

title: What an autonomous coding agent does when it says no
summary: Most autonomous coding agents stop at a pull request. Here, a second model rejected the diff twice, while the commits and release remain inspectable.
zhTitle: AI 编码 agent 说不之后，交付会怎样？

title: Claude Code in Actions: who presses merge?
summary: Claude Code Action can implement and review pull requests in your runner. It stops before merge and release. Here is the evidence-backed layer for both.
zhTitle: Claude Code 跑完之后，谁来合并 PR

title: The Docker image made it out on try three
summary: The orbi image reached GHCR and Docker Hub on its third run. The first two failures were build context and Dockerfile paths; the last an invalid tag.
zhTitle: Docker 镜像到第三次才发布成功：三次失败记录
